adjustment_journal_refs_source.name: adjustment_journal_refs_source
adjustment_journal_refs_source.value: ("adjustment_journal_refs"."kind" <> 'home_use' OR "adjustment_journal_refs"."allocation_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("adjustment_journal_refs"."kind" <> 'depreciation' OR "adjustment_journal_refs"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("adjustment_journal_refs"."kind" <> 'deferred_amortization' OR "adjustment_journal_refs"."deferred_asset_id" IS NOT NULL)

blue_deduction_answers_flags.name: blue_deduction_answers_flags
blue_deduction_answers_flags.value: "blue_deduction_answers"."double_entry" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."statements_attached" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."filed_on_time" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."e_tax" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."electronic_books" IN (0, 1)

import_batches_void.name: import_batches_void
import_batches_void.value: "import_batches"."status" = 'active' OR ("import_batches"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "import_batches"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_items_amount_match.name: invoice_items_amount_match
invoice_items_amount_match.value: "invoice_items"."quantity_halves" IS NULL OR "invoice_items"."unit_price" IS NULL OR "invoice_items"."amount" = ("invoice_items"."quantity_halves" * "invoice_items"."unit_price") / 2

partner_billing_terms_amounts.name: partner_billing_terms_amounts
partner_billing_terms_amounts.value: ("partner_billing_terms"."billing_type" = 'hourly' AND "partner_billing_terms"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_billing_terms"."unit_price" > 0 AND "partner_billing_terms"."monthly_amount" IS NULL) OR ("partner_billing_terms"."billing_type" = 'monthly' AND "partner_billing_terms"."monthly_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_billing_terms"."monthly_amount" > 0 AND "partner_billing_terms"."unit_price" IS NULL)

receipt_readings_candidates.name: receipt_readings_candidates
receipt_readings_candidates.value: "receipt_readings"."status" = 'succeeded' OR ("receipt_readings"."cand_date" IS NULL AND "receipt_readings"."cand_amount" IS NULL AND "receipt_readings"."cand_partner" IS NULL AND "receipt_readings"."cand_account_code" IS NULL AND "receipt_readings"."cand_tax_category" IS NULL AND "receipt_readings"."confidence" IS NULL)

receipt_readings_matches.name: receipt_readings_matches
receipt_readings_matches.value: ("receipt_readings"."date_match" IS NULL OR "receipt_readings"."date_match" IN (0, 1)) AND ("receipt_readings"."amount_match" IS NULL OR "receipt_readings"."amount_match" IN (0, 1)) AND ("receipt_readings"."partner_match" IS NULL OR "receipt_readings"."partner_match" IN (0, 1)) AND ("receipt_readings"."account_match" IS NULL OR "receipt_readings"."account_match" IN (0, 1)) AND ("receipt_readings"."tax_match" IS NULL OR "receipt_readings"."tax_match" IN (0, 1))

recurring_runs_shape.name: recurring_runs_shape
recurring_runs_shape.value: ("recurring_runs"."status" = 'posted' AND "recurring_runs"."journal_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("recurring_runs"."status" = 'skipped' AND "recurring_runs"."journal_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_runs"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL)

statement_accounts_account.name: statement_accounts_account
statement_accounts_account.value: ("statement_accounts"."usage" = 'private' AND "statement_accounts"."account_id" IS NULL AND "statement_accounts"."sub_account_id" IS NULL) OR ("statement_accounts"."usage" <> 'private' AND "statement_accounts"."account_id" IS NOT NULL)

statement_candidates_shape.name: statement_candidates_shape
statement_candidates_shape.value: ("statement_candidates"."method" = 'none' AND "statement_candidates"."purpose" IS NULL AND "statement_candidates"."confidence" IS NULL AND "statement_candidates"."draft_json" IS NULL) OR ("statement_candidates"."method" <> 'none' AND "statement_candidates"."purpose" IS NOT NULL AND "statement_candidates"."confidence" IS NOT NULL)
